subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What agent-visible payload format should Feishu card-action callbacks use when `form_value`, `input_value`, `name`, `option`, or `options` are present?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the permanent payload contract affects downstream agents and plugin authors, and existing linked PRs propose different shapes.

options.title: Structured JSON payload
options.body: Pass `action.value` together with Feishu form/input/select fields as JSON text while preserving legacy simple button behavior.

options.title: Command-text append
options.body: Append form/select fields into the existing command text path, minimizing surface changes but making complex values harder to parse reliably.

options.title: Pause for PR refresh
options.body: Keep the issue open until the linked PR is rebased with real Feishu proof and maintainers choose the durable format.

recommendation.title: Structured JSON payload
recommendation.body: Pass `action.value` together with Feishu form/input/select fields as JSON text while preserving legacy simple button behavior.
